Notes: EVERY UNIT ABILITY IS A TRIGGER AND AN EFFECT, joined by a colon - which is exactly how you already write them: "If you control a token: Deal 1 damage to the enemy goalie". That is why they can be rolled. This file is the two halves, and the New Class wizard in the workbench draws one of each.

Notes: A COMPOUND TRIGGER - it pays something out before it asks its question. Worth one or two in a set; a whole set of them reads the same.

Text: If you control a {token}
Notes: {token} IS THE SET'S OWN WORD. Every Emblem names one in the Token column of its Emblems file - Rose Unit, Swan, Song counter, burn counter, Teufel Mask - and it is filled in when the ability is rolled. That single placeholder is what makes nine units read as a set that belongs together rather than nine units that happen to share a class.
